[[File:Carreras_Major_security_force.jpg|thumb|right|250px|Members of the Carreras Major security force]]
The [[Shifala]] homeworld of [[Carreras Major]] had a '''security force''' around [[138 ABY]]. Members of the organization wore helmets and armor, and had a reputation for engaging in summary killings. The security force was nominally under the commander of [[Governor/Legends|Governor]] [[Biala]]. That year, the Sith impostor [[Darth Wredd]], who had assumed the identity of the [[Imperial Knight]] [[Yalta Val]], took control of the security force under the pretext of dealing with the Sith presence in the [[Carreras system/Legends|Carreras system]]. Members of the security force were involved in a manhunt for Yalta Val's missing [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]]. Four members of the security force were killed during a confrontation with the [[Junk dealer/Legends|junk dealer]] [[Ania Solo]] and her [[Mon Calamari/Legends|Mon Calamari]] friend [[Sauk]].
